items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launches, monetization expansion, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth that preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; security and operations sweeps have no results; analytics quality is yellow; Amazon evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, private launch gates, and existing evidence work. Do not approve new implementation, requeues, deployments, spend, telemetry expansion, monetization expansion, or unsupported ROI or causal-lift claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, deployed data flow and retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/configuration/retention, log and vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

SearchWoot data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because API access evidence does not establish rights to fetch, store, transform, cache, display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliate or advertising use. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized rights request. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table covering identifiers, Slack delivery, deletion, correction, access, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, and retention without enabling new tracking, then obtain jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and public/commercial use, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker.

Affiliate and analytics work may continue only conditionally within existing evidenced boundaries. Validate registered tracking IDs, destination integrity, disclosure placement, consent behavior, and deterministic link/build checks. Incomplete telemetry is not zero; the aggregate Amazon row remains unattributed, and no site revenue, ROI, or causal lift may be claimed.
